whitelist_rules.reason: The proof queues an at job for the persistence modules to find.
The proof logs in as root to set the server up.
The proof creates USER-3-0000 to give the persistence modules something to find.
The proof creates the USER-4-0000 account, as docs/USER-4-0000-account.md sets it up.

firewalld (RHEL, Rocky, Alma) runs on Python, whose ctypes has libffi make its closures in memory-only files. Only the libffi kind, only firewalld on the system's Python: another Python process with such a file stays a (low) finding, and code from a deleted or scratch file always does.
